data.name: Amrah
data.gender_notes: Amrah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Amrah is an Arabic name that signifies a person of high social standing or nobility. It is derived from the Arabic word 'amr', meaning 'command' or 'order', implying a sense of authority and respect. The name Amrah carries the meaning “High-born, Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Amrah usually hope their child will grow to embody high-born, exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Amrah is associated with the concept of 'amr bil ma'ruf', or enjoining what is good and right.
data.etymology: Amrah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “High-born, Exalted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amrah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
